def packetReady (sheets rooms pitched vertical episodes sources guardrails : Nat) (adversarial : Bool) : Bool := sheets == 5 && rooms == 56 && pitched == 10 && vertical == 1 && episodes == 7 && sources == 5 && guardrails == 6 && adversarial

theorem sourceBuildingPacketReady : packetReady 5 56 10 1 7 5 6 true = true := by native_decide

theorem missingOperationalBrainFailsComplianceClosed : packetReady 5 56 10 1 0 0 0 true = false := by native_decide

theorem unresolvedCoordinationFailsComplianceClosed : (true && false) = false := by decide
